name: background-exit
about: #208: a build ends its turn while a command runs in the background ("I'll be notified when it finishes.") and exits 0 with no .loop/result.json. The runner resumes the same session once (claude --resume <session>, a short note instead of the brief), in the same claim; the resumed run finishes and the PR opens. The first attempt's files are kept as stream-1.jsonl and brief-1.md.

run_files.text: I'll be notified when it finishes\.
^# Your run ended without a result\n\nYour last turn ended without `\.loop/result\.json`
